newsitem.title: USA: Four offers made for Barney's - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Four offers made for Barney's - NYT.

text.p: Texas Pacific Group and Ong Beng Seng, a retail executive from Singapore, were among the four bidders that came forward on Monday to meet a deadline for bids for Barney's Inc, the luxury retailer now in bankruptcy, The New York Times said.
The newspaper did not name the other bidders.
In Tuesday's edition, the paper said that while Saks Holdings Inc declined to improve on its earlier bid of $290 million, Dickson Concepts Inc, a Hong Kong company, may be considering an amended bid.
The newspaper cited unnamed sources close to the situation.
The company will have several weeks to consider the bids, the newspaper said.
